house.description: Funding provided to Explore Minnesota for a grant to Twin Cities in Motion, and money appropriated.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Workforce, Labor, and Economic Development Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; appropriating money to Explore Minnesota for a grant to Twin Cities In Motion.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$3,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the director of Explore Minnesota for a grant to Twin Cities In Motion for costs related to hosting the Twin Cities Marathon. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2029. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; appropriating money to Explore Minnesota for a grant to Twin Cities In Motion.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION.

$3,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the director of Explore Minnesota for a grant to Twin Cities In Motion for costs related to hosting the Twin Cities Marathon. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2029.
additions: $3,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the director of Explore Minnesota for a grant to Twin Cities In Motion for costs related to hosting the Twin Cities Marathon. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2029.
